title.en: Two registry writes in one tweak
title.tr: Tek tweakte iki kayit defteri yazimi

why.en: C8 fixture: apply writes two values and names no compound.
why.tr: C8 fiksturu: apply iki deger yazar ve bir bilesik adlandirmaz.

apply: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\FpsTuneFixture' -Name A -Value $Target; New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\FpsTuneFixture' -Name B -Value $Target -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
